description: Permanently delete a draft document. Only drafts can be deleted; a sent document is part of the signing record, so use void_document to cancel it instead.

api_key.description: An md2sign API key. When given, this call uses that key's account even if the connection is signed in as someone else, so pass it on every call when your human has more than one md2sign account (for example two businesses). Also use it if your MCP client cannot send an "Authorization: Bearer <api_key>" header.

document_id.description: The draft document ID returned by create_draft, list_documents or create_document_from_template.

name: delete_document
title: Delete a draft document
